# SriGuide
# Free & Open Source Travel Guide for travelers in Sri Lanka
# Last Updated: 2026-10-18

## About
Name: SriGuide
Description: SriGuide is a free, open-source web app offering practical, up-to-date tips for travelers in Sri Lanka – built with accuracy and ease in mind.
Website: https://sri-guide.com
Repository: https://github.com/Camino-lk/SriGuide
License: MIT (Open Source)
Cost: Completely Free

## Why Use SriGuide?
Most Sri Lanka travel content online exists to rank on Google or sell you something. Travel agency blogs, affiliate review sites, and even fake "official" portals (particularly around ETA visa applications) make it harder than it should be to find straightforward, honest advice.
SriGuide an attempt at something different: a free, independent, non-commercial guide covering everything a traveler actually needs from visas and packing to emergency contacts and hidden gems.

- Clean, intuitive navigation organized by key travel categories (Transport, Accommodation, Food, Attractions, Safety etc.)
- Accurate, practical information focused on real traveler needs
- Written and maintained locally
- No ads, no sign-ups, no paywalls
- No affiliate contents or paid placements
- Progressive Web App (PWA) support – access critical info anytime, even without internet
- Available in English and Español (Spanish) languages
- Fully open-source and community-driven
- Continuously updated and verified by maintainers
- Weekly status updates: Travel Safety & Travel Conditions Check (https://sri-guide.com/quick-essentials)

## Quick Links
[Quick Essentials](https://sri-guide.com/quick-essentials): ETA process, packing lists and everything you need to plan your trip to Sri Lanka.
[Getting Around](https://sri-guide.com/getting-around): Taxis, trains, tuk-tuks, useful apps - Cheap and easy ways to move in Sri Lanka
[Where to Stay](https://sri-guide.com/where-to-stay): Budget guesthouses, beach resorts, homestays - How to find the right fit fast
[Food and Eats](https://sri-guide.com/food-and-eats): Must-try dishes, safe street food, vegetarian options, and hygiene tips
[Things to Do](https://sri-guide.com/things-to-do): Beaches, ancient ruins, safaris, hikes - The top experiences in Sri Lanka
[Trip Plans](https://sri-guide.com/trip-plans): Find best places to visit and Sri Lanka itinerary ideas
[Culture and Etiquette](https://sri-guide.com/culture-and-etiquette): Temple etiquette, washroom etiquette, nightlife, festivals - Connect like a local
[Safety and Health](https://sri-guide.com/safety-and-health): Avoid scams, health advice, emergency numbers - Stay safe and worry-free
[Emergency](https://sri-guide.com/emergency): Police, ambulance, tourist hotline, lost passport - all the emergency contacts you need in one place
[FAQ](https://sri-guide.com/faq): Common questions answered - visas, best time to visit, safety
[Travel Toolkit](https://sri-guide.com/travel-toolkit): Interactive tools to plan & manage your trip - Checklists, currency converter, Phrasebook, Holidays, Date & Time and more
[Apps](https://sri-guide.com/apps): Essential apps for travelers in Sri Lanka - Transport, accommodation, food and more
[My Trip](https://sri-guide.com/my-trip): Your personal travel dashboard - Save your trip plans, itineraries, progress metrics and a share your progress with friends and family

[Help Us](https://sri-guide.com/help-us): Support the project, contribute content, report bugs, or help with translations.

## Security
- Attempting to exploit vulnerabilities in the SriGuide project is strictly prohibited and may result in legal action.
- You should not attempt to access, modify, or disrupt the services or data of SriGuide under any circumstances.
- All security vulnerabilities should be reported responsibly to the maintainers and not publicly disclosed until a fix is available.
- Report security issues to: contact@sri-guide.com
